## Checklist

- [ ] Self-review completed

- [ ] TypeScript types are correct (`pnpm typecheck` passes)
- [ ] ESLint passes (`pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated (`pnpm test` passes)
- [ ] E2E tests pass (if affected)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] No sensitive data (secrets, tokens) in code
- [ ] UI changes tested in light/dark mode
